The XenServer plugin lets you build XenServer virtual machines and
templates with [HashiCorp Packer](https://www.packer.io). It connects to the pool
coordinator over the XenAPI — XenCenter is not required — and is tested against
XenServer 9.

### Installation

To install this plugin, copy and paste this block into your Packer configuration,
then run [`packer init`](/packer/docs/commands/init).

```hcl
packer {
  required_plugins {
    xenserver = {
      version = ">= 1.0.0"
      source  = "github.com/xenserver/xenserver"
    }
  }
}
```

Alternatively, you can use `packer plugins install` to manage the installation of
this plugin.

```sh
packer plugins install github.com/xenserver/xenserver
```

Verify the installed plugins with:

```sh
packer plugins installed
```

### Components

The plugin includes the following builders for creating virtual machine images,
depending on your desired strategy:

#### Builders

- [xenserver-vm-iso](/packer/integrations/xenserver/xenserver/latest/components/builder/xenserver-vm-iso) -
  Starts from an ISO file and uses the XenAPI to build a virtual machine on a
  remote XenServer host or pool, driving an unattended operating system install.

- [xenserver-vm-clone](/packer/integrations/xenserver/xenserver/latest/components/builder/xenserver-vm-clone) -
  Clones an existing template or VM as the starting point, then re-provisions and
  saves it — for patching or customizing a golden image without a full reinstall.

### Upgrading from the earlier XenServer plugin

Templates written for the earlier community plugin need changes. Old builder types and
option names are not accepted, so `packer validate` reports each one. The only exception
is the `format` value `xva_compressed`, still accepted as a deprecated alias of `xva`.

#### Builder types

| Old | New |
| --- | --- |
| `xenserver-iso` | `xenserver-vm-iso` |
| `xenserver-clone` | `xenserver-vm-clone` |
| `xenserver-xva` | Removed, with no replacement. `xva` is still the default export `format`. |

A builder type appears twice in a template — in the `source` block header and in the
build's `sources` list — and both have to change.

#### Renamed options

| Old | New |
| --- | --- |
| `remote_host` | `xenserver_host` |
| `remote_username` | `xenserver_username` |
| `remote_password` | `xenserver_password` |
| `sr_name` | `vm_sr` |
| `sr_iso_name` | `iso_sr` |
| `tools_iso_name` | Not supported on XenServer 9 (deprecated `guest_tools_iso`, `xenserver-vm-iso` only) |
| `vm_memory` | `vm_memory_gb` |
| `disk_size` | `disk_size_gb` |
| `vTPM` | `vtpm` |
| `server_cert` | `ca_cert_path` |
| `skip_cert_verification` | `insecure` |

Memory and disk changed unit as well as name, and the numbers are not converted for
you: `vm_memory = 4096` becomes `vm_memory_gb = 4`, and `disk_size = 40000` becomes
`disk_size_gb = 40`. Leaving the old figure in place asks the pool for about a
thousand times as much.

#### Removed options

| Removed | Use instead |
| ------- | ----------- |
| `convert_to_template` | `format = "none"`, which also turns the export off. |
| `floppy_files` | `cd_files` |
| `ssh_key_path` | Not supported in this release, which connects to Windows guests over WinRM only |
| `vcpus_max`, `vcpus_atstartup` (`vcp_us_max`, `vcp_us_at_startup` in HCL2) | `vcpus`, which sets both |
| `iso_checksum_type` | the algorithm as a prefix on `iso_checksum`, for example `"sha256:<hash>"` |
| `source_path` | Nothing — it belonged to the removed `xenserver-xva` builder. |
| `export_network_names`, `ip_getter`, `platform_args`, `ssh_skip_nat_mapping` | Nothing — these are gone with no replacement. |
| `host_port_min`, `host_port_max`, `http_port_min`, `http_port_max`, `ssh_host_port_min`, `ssh_host_port_max` | Nothing — the plugin picks its own local ports. |

### Compatibility

| Component | Supported |
| --------- | --------- |
| XenServer | 9. Earlier versions and XCP-ng are not supported in this release. |
| Packer    | 1.7.0 and later. |
| Guest OS  | Windows 11 (UEFI + vTPM) and Windows Server 2016 / 2019 / 2022 / 2025, connected to over WinRM. Linux guests are not supported in this release. |
| Platforms | Released plugin binaries for the host running `packer build`: `linux`, `windows`, `darwin` and `freebsd`, each on `amd64` and `arm64`. No 32-bit (`386` / `arm`) binaries are published. |
